source.line: Después del paso del maestro llegó una mujer que caminaba de noche.

action: Two deliberate alternating steps: B in the first second, A in the second.
method: Sequential reviewed unmasked GPT edits of a fixed enlarged crop at high quality; accepted local region recomposited over the original using a fixed feathered mask. No temporal interpolation or repeated frames.

frames.phase: Original b1a, unchanged.
frames.action: Use the original b1a photograph, unchanged.

frames.phase: Transfer weight onto A; B's heel rises slightly.
frames.action: Transfer her weight onto foot A. Lift only the heel of trailing foot B a little, leaving its toes on the same road contact point. A stays planted.
frames.review_note: Identity, scale, mantle and head preserved. A remains at original contact; B heel and ankle lift slightly. Accepted after rejecting the reconstructed a01 candidate.
frames.phase_es: Peso sobre A; sube el talón de B

frames.phase: B's toe releases from the road.
frames.action: Lift the toes of trailing foot B off the road. A still carries her weight at the same contact point. A small visible gap must appear under B.
frames.review_note: B toes now clear the road; A remains planted. Face, garment and body scale remain consistent with the anchor.

frames.phase: B's knee bends and begins the forward swing.
frames.action: Bend the knee of leg B and start swinging B forward, still behind the supporting leg. B is clearly airborne; A stays planted.
frames.review_note: B knee bends and foot is clearly airborne behind A. A contact, face, head size and mantle identity are preserved.

frames.phase: B moves forward toward the supporting leg.
frames.action: Bring the raised foot B farther forward toward leg A, without yet passing A. Keep the supporting foot A fixed against the same stones.
frames.review_note: Retry keeps B airborne and advances it toward the supporting leg without an early landing. A contact and original identity remain stable.

frames.phase: B reaches the passing position under the pelvis.
frames.action: Bring foot B into the passing position beneath her pelvis, beside the supporting leg. B stays above the road; both legs remain distinct.
frames.review_note: B is raised beside the support leg under the pelvis; A stays planted. Minor arm and mantle response, stable face and proportions.

frames.phase: B moves beyond A toward the camera.
frames.action: Advance the raised foot B beyond A toward the camera. B must now visibly pass the supporting foot in depth. A stays planted.
frames.review_note: B swings forward with a raised sole oriented toward landing, instead of repeating the hanging rear-foot pose. A remains planted; face and body scale consistent.

frames.phase: B's lower leg extends, heel approaching the path.
frames.action: Extend the lower leg B forward and lower its heel toward the road, with its toes slightly raised. B has not touched down yet. A remains at its old contact.
frames.review_note: B extends toward the camera with toes raised and sole visible before heel landing. A remains planted. Identity and mantle remain recognizable; numerical guide is approximate.

frames.phase: B's heel makes the new contact ahead of A.
frames.action: Place the heel of B on the road ahead of A. Keep its toes slightly lifted for this contact pose. This is brief double support; the forward foot has changed.
frames.review_note: B heel now lands visibly ahead and lower in the image than planted A, with toes lifted. Some mantle folds change; face, gaze and figure scale remain consistent.

frames.phase: B's sole lowers to the road.
frames.action: Lower the sole of B fully onto the road ahead of A. A remains behind at its previous contact. B is now unmistakably the leading foot.
frames.review_note: B sole is now flat on the road ahead of A, with visible heel-to-sole transition. Face and scale stable; mantle folds show modest variation.

frames.phase: Weight moves onto B; A's heel begins to lift.
frames.action: Transfer her weight onto planted foot B. Raise the heel of trailing A slightly, keeping A toes in contact and the new B contact fixed.
frames.review_note: B stays planted ahead while A heel rises behind; a small weight transfer is visible. Some cloth texture and local color variation remain for final review.

frames.phase: Settle over B with a slight knee bend.
frames.action: Settle gently over foot B with a small bend of the supporting knee. A trails on its toes. Complete this single step without beginning a second leg swing.
frames.review_note: Subtle settling over planted B, with A still trailing and heel released. The pause is small; cloth shading changes more than torso position.

frames.phase: Apoyo sobre B
frames.action: Keep foot B planted in front. Continue transferring weight over B and raise the trailing A heel a little farther; A toes still touch the old contact point.
frames.review_note: B remains the forward support. A lifts slightly farther behind, approaching toe release; gaze tilts subtly upward and will be checked in the final sequence.

frames.phase: Despegue de A
frames.action: Lift the trailing foot A toes off the road. B remains planted at its new front contact point. A is now visibly airborne behind B.
frames.review_note: A toes are clearly off the road with a visible gap, while B sole holds its forward contact. Face remains recognizable, with slight expression drift.

frames.phase: Flexión de A
frames.action: Bend the knee of trailing leg A and begin swinging A forward. B continues supporting her at the same ground contact.
frames.review_note: A knee visibly bends and its airborne foot rises, with B staying planted. The lifted hem responds to the knee without extra limbs.

frames.phase: Avance de A
frames.action: Move the raised A foot forward toward the supporting leg B. Keep A behind B for this exposure; keep B planted.
frames.review_note: A moves forward and slightly downward while remaining airborne; B contact is stable. Knee and hem shift together. The foot height differs from the approximate pose guide.

frames.phase: A se acerca al apoyo
frames.action: Bring the raised A ankle closer to B under the pelvis, with a small knee bend. Keep the two legs separate and B fixed to the road.
frames.review_note: A advances closer to the supporting leg, its toes still above the road. B stays flat; body translation is smaller than the planned guide.

frames.phase: Paso de A junto a B
frames.action: Bring foot A into the passing position beside planted B, toes clear of the road. The supporting foot B does not slide.
frames.review_note: A reaches the passing phase beside B with its lower leg extended and foot still airborne. Support remains B. Hair and cloth show small regenerated-detail changes.

frames.phase: A supera a B
frames.action: Swing foot A beyond B toward the camera. A must visibly pass B in depth. Keep B at its contact point.
frames.review_note: A swings toward the camera with its sole turning forward and toes raised, beside the stationary B contact. It is approaching the forward landing rather than fully planted.

frames.phase: Extensión de A
frames.action: Extend the lower leg A forward and lower its heel toward the road ahead of B. A has not landed yet; B still supports her.
frames.review_note: A extends beyond B with raised toes and a small remaining gap beneath the heel. B remains the support. Forward displacement is modest rather than the full numerical guide.

frames.phase: Contacto de A
frames.action: Place the A heel on the path ahead of B. Keep A toes slightly raised at first contact. Both legs are now in brief double support.
frames.review_note: A heel reaches a new contact in front of B while its toes remain lifted. B retains rear support. The stride is small; original facial identity will be held during final composition.

frames.phase: Planta de A
frames.action: Lower the A sole fully to the road ahead of B. A is now the leading foot and B trails. Preserve both identities and the same path.
frames.review_note: A sole is clearly flat in front of B, completing the second heel-to-sole transition. B is behind and beginning to release weight.

frames.phase: Peso sobre A
frames.action: Transfer weight onto planted A. Raise the trailing B heel gently while B toes still touch the old contact point. A stays fixed.

frames.phase: Asentamiento final
frames.action: Settle over planted A with a slight knee bend and restrained arm counterbalance. B trails on its toes. Finish the second step, ready to keep walking.

adaptations.change: Single previous accepted image after two rejected two-reference attempts. The original is kept as an external visual review reference instead of a generation input from this point, to avoid resetting the leg pose.
